metadata.capability_extraction: Can right-click dock icons, navigate context menus, select menu items
metadata.explanation: Direct verification of the core task: vim.desktop must be absent and thunderbird.desktop + google-chrome.desktop must remain. Uses built-in check_gnome_favorite_apps which does exact set comparison via gsettings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps' to read the GNOME favorite apps list directly from system settings — no UI dependency, no postconfig needed.
Metric check_gnome_favorite_apps correctly parses the gsettings output string and verifies exact set equality with a length check, ensuring vim.desktop is absent and no extra apps were added.

Parameter handling is correct: the function receives the rules dict as the second positional argument and accesses rule['expected'] directly, which resolves to ['thunderbird.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop'].
Expected value ['thunderbird.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop'] is semantically correct — it matches the initial 3-app state minus vim.desktop, exactly what the task requires.
Negative control resistance is solid: the initial state has 3 apps while the expected has 2, so the length check immediately fails for a do-nothing agent.
Full instruction coverage: verifying the exact set ensures vim.desktop is absent AND all other apps (thunderbird, chrome) remain intact.
